name: Durga Mandir, Rajpur Road
town_description: Dehradun is the capital city of Uttarakhand, set in the Doon Valley at the foothills of the Himalayas. Rajpur Road is one of the city's main commercial arteries running north from the city centre toward Rajpur and Mussoorie; Jakhan is a locality along it.

travel.road: On Rajpur Road near Jakhan, in the north of Dehradun city; accessible by auto, taxi or local bus
